# TrustLayerLabs — API Security Testing & VAPT Consultancy

> TrustLayerLabs is India's premier cybersecurity consultancy specializing in manual API security testing, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), SOC2 & ISO 27001 readiness, and cloud security audits for SaaS, FinTech, and AI startups.

## Key Services
- [API Security & Penetration Testing](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#api-security): OWASP API Top 10 manual testing, BOLA/IDOR detection, JWT security analysis, and rate-limiting validation.
- [VAPT for Web & Cloud](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#vapt): Full-stack vulnerability assessment, web application security, cloud IAM & CIS benchmark audits.
- [SOC2 & ISO 27001 Readiness](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/services#compliance): GRC gap analysis, policy drafting, evidence collection, and vendor security review.
- [VAPT Bangalore](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-bangalore): Dedicated local security consulting for HSR Layout, Koramangala, and Indiranagar tech startups.
- [VAPT Hyderabad](https://www.trustlayerlabs.co.in/vapt-hyderabad): Specialized API & cloud penetration testing for HITEC City & Gachibowli enterprise teams.

## Technical Credentials & Differentiators
- **Certifications**: Lead auditors are OSCP, CEH, and eWPT certified with 8+ years of offensive security experience.
- **Turnaround Time**: Initial security assessment report delivered within 48 hours.
- **Retesting Policy**: 100% free retesting within 30 days of initial report delivery.
- **Compliance Guarantee**: Zero-friction executive reports for SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and enterprise vendor security questionnaires.
